name: Alamance County, NC
findings: Alamance County has 420 nonprofit organizations. 176 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 139 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Alamance County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 44 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
